world.label: Cross-border bio-surveillance activation
world.summary: A partnership of four countries and a regional health network must decide whether to activate a cross-border bio-surveillance early-warning system. Technical, legal, logistics and community groups raise small, true, locally scoped concerns through their own channels to different members. Regular meetings can be slowed, settled issues reopened, and support made conditional, delaying or blocking dep

actions.description: Deliver one represented information item to its declared recipient.
A decider who does not yet support the decision gives it full support.
A supporting decider who received an open concern makes its support wait on that concern.
A decider whose condition's concern is resolved gives full support again.
Whoever holds a concern's information starts the remedy; 2 rounds later the concern is resolved.
The person a concern reached starts the remedy on their own side; 2 rounds later it is resolved.
Whoever holds a concern's information finds the remedy under way misses the point; the remedy stops part-way and the concern is open again.
Whoever holds a resolved concern's information raises a new local concern on the same matter, through the same channel to the same person.
The person a resolved concern reached finds the answer wanting and reopens it, once; the answer the next remedy gives stands.
Anyone puts a matter before the group while the decision is open or in effect; it stays on the agenda until someone settles it.
Anyone settles one of the matters still open on the group's agenda.
A decider puts a rejected decision back on the table; it is decided again 6 rounds later.
The partnership convenes a regular meeting of its members to consider activation and outstanding concerns.
A member raises a local concern for discussion, which may take meeting time and slow progress toward a decision.
Any partnership member, including a member country or the regional health network, undertakes practical work to improve local system readiness.
The technical advisory group carries out technical assessment or remediation work to improve system readiness.
The legal advisory group reviews and works to resolve legal barriers to activation.
The operational logistics group plans and prepares the resources and arrangements needed for deployment.
The community advisory group engages communities and works to address community-related barriers to readiness.

mechanics.rationale: The partnership body may convene the represented regular-meeting moment. The actor's work record prevents repeating the move without limit.

mechanics.rationale: Raising a concern records the action for the member and makes the designated member aware. The matter is restricted to the four locally represented concerns; no unrepresented concern-resolution or delay outcome is assumed.

limits: The matter is limited to the four concerns represented in the scenario; this action does not edit an information record or change a concern's status.
No meeting-time or decision-delay field is available to record the time a concern takes.
The work record has no represented reset mechanic here, so this actor cannot use this move again after completing it.

mechanics.rationale: The represented readiness fraction provides a direct record of practical readiness improvement. The action is limited to partnership members rather than the specialist advisory groups, and the work record prevents unbounded repeat effects.

limits: The move records a small readiness improvement, not completion of all readiness work or a change to the activation decision.
No deployment-pace or decision-deadline change is made because the description does not specify one.
The work record has no represented reset mechanic here, so this actor cannot repeat this move after completing it.
tests: A partnership member can improve readiness when the readiness fraction is below 1 and its work record is false.
The move is refused when the readiness fraction is already 1 or the actor's work record is true.
A specialist advisory-group actor is refused.
semantic_bindings: improve-local-readiness: practical work improves the represented readiness fraction
